Scaling that fast usually means more in-market accounts than the BD team can cover before new reps ramp, and that gap is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings DataHub needs to hit target this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
